## Current Architecture

The revised LaTeX proposal puts **position PI and PWM in the FPGA**. The MCU reads the ADC using SPI DMA, estimates gap, and handles the web interface. Current supports field compensation, telemetry, and protection; the revised plan has no current-feedback controller.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  UI["Hardware webpage: target, graph, gains, Stop"] <--> WIFI[ESP8266]
  WIFI <-->|UART| MCU["STM32: ADC DMA and gap estimate"]
  H["Hall A above / Hall B below electromagnet"] --> ADC[MCP3204 ADC]
  I[Current sensor] --> ADC
  ADC -->|SPI DMA| MCU
  MCU <-->|"SPI: gap, target, current, status, gains"| FPGA["UPduino: position PI and PWM"]
  FPGA --> DRIVER["Gate driver and MOSFET"]
  DRIVER --> EM[12 V electromagnet]
  EM --> OBJECT["Suspended magnet and payload"]
  OBJECT -. field .-> H
  EM -. field .-> H
  ESTOP["E-stop and overcurrent comparator"] -->|direct disable| DRIVER
```

| Function | Owner | Proposed rate |
|---|---|---|
| Three-channel ADC scan | MCU SPI DMA | 5 kHz |
| Calibrated gap estimate | MCU | 1 kHz |
| Position PI | FPGA | 1 kHz |
| PWM | FPGA | 20 kHz |
| Web communication | MCU and ESP8266 | 125000-baud UART |
| Loss-of-command shutdown | FPGA | 50 ms nominal timeout |

These rates need hardware verification. At 1 MHz SPI, the proposal budgets 75 microseconds for three ADC readings and 68 microseconds for an example eight-byte exchange: 143 of 200 microseconds. The revised position/gain packet still needs a defined layout. Include its final length, validation, and processing in the measured timing budget.

## Gap and Position Control

Surface gap $d$ runs downward from the electromagnet's bottom face to the suspended magnet's top face. The proposal commits to 10–20 mm motion with a 10 g total moving mass. The force-model distance $z$ runs from the coil plane to the magnet center: $z=d+\Delta_g$, where the offset depends on actual geometry.

For downward displacement, $m\ddot d=mg-F(d,i)$. Define $e=\hat d-r$, where $r$ is requested gap. The proposed controller is

$$u=\operatorname{clamp}\left(u_0+K_pe+K_i\int e\,dt,\;0,\;u_{\max}\right).$$

A positive error increases attraction. Duty limits, integrator anti-windup, range-checked gains, and applying both gains together at an update boundary are part of the implementation plan. Numeric gains require the measured plant and confirmed units.

## Resolution and Calibration

Both Hall sensors see the electromagnet, fixed helper magnet, and moving payload. Read them on separate ADC channels, then combine their readings with measured current in software. Two sensors alone do not guarantee coil-field cancellation.

For calibrated differential voltage $V_\Delta(d)$, the local quantization estimate is

$$\Delta d_{\mathrm{LSB}}\approx\frac{V_{\mathrm{ref}}/4096}{|dV_\Delta/dd|}.$$

At the proposed 3.3 V reference, one count is approximately 0.806 mV. Measure the voltage slope across the operating range. Noise, channel skew, alignment, and calibration also limit usable resolution and accuracy. The separate November sensing notes used a 5 V ADC example; their numerical position increments do not establish performance for this 3.3 V design.

A fixed helper magnet can change the equilibrium force and force gradient. Shifting the Hall baseline does not itself improve position resolution. Check sensor headroom and calibrate the complete assembly with the helper magnet installed.

## Stability Calculation

The [calculation summary](overleaf_10mm/calculation_summary.pdf) develops the local model around equilibrium. Define $x=d-d_0$, $j=i-i_0$, and upward force $F\simeq mg-k_xx+k_fj$. With resistance $R$, inductance $L$, passive damping $c$, and supply $V_s$, position PI gives

$$mLs^4+(mR+cL)s^3+(cR-k_xL+k_f^2)s^2+(k_fV_sK_p-k_xR)s+k_fV_sK_i=0.$$

The illustrative air-core model at **10 mm center distance**, with 10 g mass, 500 turns, 10 mm coil radius, $R=8\,\Omega$, $L=10$ mH, and negligible passive damping, has a negative $s^2$ coefficient. No PI gains make that assumed continuous model strictly stable. The sampled example is also unstable. These calculations do not validate gains for the selected iron-core electromagnet.

Measure holding current, hot resistance, inductance, and local force slopes using the final payload and helper magnet. Check continuous and sampled stability, including acquisition and communication delay, before free suspension. Stable poles and position tolerance are separate checks; the proposal's endpoint demonstration band is ±5 mm.

## Implementation Status

The main application sources and [October 26 verification](docs/verification.qmd) cover MCU position control with FPGA current PI. They are retained as earlier evidence. The revised FPGA position controller, gain-update contract, and graph interface still need implementation and verification.
